name: com.cssalt.phone-gyro
description: Drive Unity Transforms from a phone's gyroscope and on-screen joystick via a small Node.js WebSocket relay. Multiple phones can share a room, each tagging their messages with a target name so one phone drives the probe while another drives the needle. Includes the RoomQR WebGL template (QR-code pairing) and a UrlBridge.jslib for reading the hosting page's room ID at runtime.

samples.description: Example script that lets the user click on a skin mesh to position the probe at the clicked point with its face flush against the surface normal. Useful pattern for any 'place this object on geometry' interaction.
